name: Greg Ganske
bio: A Representative from Iowa; born in New Hampton, Chickasaw County, Iowa, March 31, 1949; B.A., University of Iowa, Iowa City, Iowa, 1972; M.D., University of Iowa Medical School, Iowa City, Iowa, 1976; general surgery training, University of Colorado Medical Center, Denver, Colo., and Oregon Health Science Center, Portland, Oreg., 1976-1982; plastic surgery training, Harvard Medical School, Cambridge, Mass., 1982-1984; surgeon; United States Army Reserve, 1986-2001; farm manager; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Fourth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1995-January 3, 2003); not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Eighth Congress in 2002, but was an unsuccessful candidate for election to the United States Senate; is a resident of Des Moines, Iowa.
